newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KFA passes on 52,500T of corn tender.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KFA passes on 52,500T of corn tender.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Feed Association (KFA) passed on a tender to buy 52,500 tonnes of corn due to high offer prices, traders said on Tuesday.

Traders said the lowest bids were made by Japanese trading house Tomen Corp with seller's option at $129.25 a tonne C&F if sourced from China, at $134.25 a tonne C&F if from the Pacific Northwest or at $133.25 a tonne C&F if from the U.S. Gulf.
Arrival of the passed tender was set by October 5 to South Korea's western port of Inchon.
Shipment was slated for September 16-October 5 if sourced from China, for September 4-23 if from the Pacific Northwest or for August 15-September 3 if from the U.S. Gulf.
